method: 30-second visible requestAnimationFrame sample after 8-second warmup; actual Three.js production page; all frame stalls retained. Quality forced for stable comparison.
limitations: Both measured on the same Mac. Responsive viewport is not physical iOS/Android testing. These samples measure browser presentation cadence, not isolated GPU time.

adaptiveGraphicsRegression.before: Both automatic quality steps reproduced environment disappearing after shadow texture disposal.
adaptiveGraphicsRegression.fix: Disable sun.castShadow and invalidate scene materials before disposing shadow texture.
adaptiveGraphicsRegression.after: Same two downgrade actions preserved the full environment and persistent ball.
